svg.title: ECR pull-through cache internals
svg.desc: Each consumer pulls the stable-alpine tag from the cached repository in the ECR private registry and reads its own platform's manifest from the image index. On a cache miss, ECR's service-linked role reads the Docker Hub token from Secrets Manager and copies the index and its 16 manifests from Docker Hub.
